hypotheses.J1_joint_program_transfers_across_fisher: On the independent Fisher sketch, the first-sketch greedy set reaches at least 80% of the second-sketch greedy objective on both corpora.
hypotheses.J2_joint_program_is_constructive: The greedy set's held-out signed joint energy is at least 75% of the sum of its individual held-out energies on both corpora.
hypotheses.J3_joint_program_beats_diagonal_finite_e: The greedy set has at least twice the exact native KL of the natural-component Fisher-diagonal set on both corpora.
hypotheses.J4_joint_program_beats_local_finite_effe: The greedy set has at least as much exact native KL as the local-score oracle on both corpora.
hypotheses.J5_local_program_retains_query_advantage: The local-score oracle has at least twice the absolute direct query effect of the joint Fisher program on both corpora.
hypotheses.J6_joint_support_is_recurrent: Independent Fisher sketches recover at least 50% of the greedy top-16 support on both corpora.
hypotheses.J7_joint_program_does_not_require_extrem: The median scale applied to the selected natural projection is at most 10 on both corpora.
